m_969cbddc6c07.en: A little space for your ideas.
m_969cbddc6c07.zh-Hant: 留一點空間給你的想法。

m_c9fee936e9d5.en: Fullscreen is unavailable. Focus mode is still available.
m_c9fee936e9d5.zh-Hant: 無法使用全螢幕；仍可使用專注模式。

m_fba9c74ca9b7.en: Refresh Whiteboard to keep editing this newer board. Your local changes are retained.
m_fba9c74ca9b7.zh-Hant: 請重新整理白板，以繼續編輯新版文件。本機修改已保留。

m_48191194fcef.en: Named vector boards up to 2 MB and 10,000 elements; text, shapes, arrows and free drawing.
m_48191194fcef.zh-Hant: 具名向量白板最多 2 MB、10,000 個元素；支援文字、形狀、箭頭和自由繪畫。

m_427539690bc0.en: Choose New or Continue to open the canvas. Boards holds Personal and Shared records. More contains exports, templates and drawing preferences. Keep tool active repeats your drawing tool; Snap to points connects arrows to 12 points on each shape. Background offers five paper styles that follow the scene. Fullscreen requires a supported browser; focus mode remains available.
m_427539690bc0.zh-Hant: 選擇新建或繼續，即可開啟畫布。「白板清單」收納個人與共享記錄；「更多」提供匯出、範本與繪圖偏好。「連續繪圖」保留目前工具；「吸附連接點」可將箭頭連到形狀上的 12 個連接點。「背景」提供五種隨場景移動的紙張樣式。全螢幕需瀏覽器支援，亦可使用專注模式。

m_f63b4c4bcd33.en: Personal boards sync privately; Shared supports four signed-in members. Paper and arrow bindings belong to the document. Tool lock, selection and viewport are personal. Images and external embeds are unsupported. Guest boards require Copy to account.
m_f63b4c4bcd33.zh-Hant: 個人白板以私人方式同步，共享白板支援四名已登入成員。紙張及箭頭綁定屬於文件；工具鎖定、選取及視角屬個人設定。不支援圖片和外部嵌入內容。訪客白板需透過「複製至帳號」匯入。

m_be255095d53f.en: Whiteboard changed. Prepare a new PNG.
m_be255095d53f.zh-Hant: 白板已變更，請重新準備 PNG。
